title: NRI bookings bill an INR-scaled number as USD — /from-offering multiplies an INR base price by 9 and charges it in dollars
Video proof is never enforced — a booking can reach `delivered` with videoProofUrl null
Unverified temples are bookable — neither the booking path nor the default temple listing filters on isVerified
Reschedule accepts an arbitrary time-slot string, bypassing the availableSlots whitelist and maxBookingsPerSlot capacity
Admin priest reassignment via PATCH /bookings/:id is a silent no-op that returns 200
Slot capacity is enforced by a count-then-create race with no transaction and no DB constraint — concurrent bookings oversell a slot
puja_bookings has no index on priest_id or temple_puja_offering_id — both are on the booking hot path
Unbounded findMany on the payouts summary and in the stale-booking escalation cron
Cancel and reschedule measure the 24h window from midnight instead of the actual slot time, denying devotees up to 23 hours of their entitled window
Booking-number generation is a check-then-insert race, and the /from-offering copy silently gives up after 5 collisions
Puja Commission ledger stores the platform's 20% cut in the field the payout engine pays out as the provider's 80% share
Cancellation refund ladder is computed and quoted to the devotee but never applied — every refund is issued at 100%
Temple 5% share (TEMPLE_SHARE_RATE) is never written on the real money path — TemplePayout is unreachable for any paid booking
getPayoutBalance double-subtracts in-flight commissions, locking providers out of newly earned balance
Priest Aadhaar payout gate (business rule 4) is bypassed by the unified #233 payout path
processRefund fires the Razorpay refund outside any transaction, allowing a second full refund after a mid-flight crash
Duplicate Commission writer in booking.service.ts still runs post-transaction with swallowed errors and float math
Money handled as JS float in refund webhooks, temple share, and payout balance aggregation
Concurrent payout requests can mint two PayoutRequest rows for the same balance
demo-pay writes a stale 30/70 split that violates the uniform 20/80 take-rate doctrine
Refund ladder is never applied — every refund executed is 100% of the captured amount
POST /bookings/:id/cancel refunds nothing and is not even queued for refund — the web Cancel button silently keeps the customer's money
Cancellation/refund writes no compensating ledger entry — the pandit's Commission stays PENDING and withdrawable on a refunded booking
Reschedule bypasses the slot whitelist and per-slot capacity, and accepts a time that has already passed today
Puja Commission rows credit the platform's 20% cut as the pandit's withdrawable balance
No booking confirmation email is ever sent; the template is dead code and the other two channels are both no-ops by default
cancel-quote computes the refund tier against midnight instead of the slot time, quoting devotees a worse tier than policy
Web Cancel button ignores the API response and always renders "cancelled", including on a 409 rejection
The 'refund' notification event is defined but never fired — refund notice depends entirely on Resend being configured
